# NeuralNg Textarea

> Native Angular 22+ multiline text enhancement at @neural-ng/core/textarea.

RULES
- Import NeuralTextarea from @neural-ng/core/textarea. TextareaComponent is a deprecated compatibility alias.
- Generate <textarea neuralTextarea>, never <neural-textarea> and never an internal wrapper.
- Keep rows, cols, name, placeholder, autocomplete, wrap, required, disabled, readonly, minlength, and maxlength on the native textarea.
- Use a native label or another valid accessible name. Placeholder is not a label.
- Use native input and change events. Do not invent valueChange or textChange.
- Bind Angular Signal Forms [formField] directly to the native host. Do not add a ControlValueAccessor.
- With [formField], define constraints such as maxLength in the Signal Forms schema; do not duplicate them as maxlength attributes on that host. FormField reflects the schema constraint to the native attribute.
- Without [formField], native minlength and maxlength attributes remain valid.
- autoResize defaults to false and uses CSS field-sizing: content.
- When autoResize is true, rows and cols do not determine preferred size. Constrain growth with NeuralNg auto min/max block-size tokens or consumer CSS.
- resizeMode accepts vertical, horizontal, both, or none and defaults to vertical.
- autoResize takes precedence over resizeMode.
- Use normal class and [class.*] bindings; there is no textareaClass input.
- fluid affects width only in styled mode.
- unstyled removes visual, fluid, resize, and auto-resize classes but preserves neural-textarea-root, data attributes, consumer classes, and native behavior.
- Inside neural-field, Textarea inherits ID, descriptions, required, invalid, pending, disabled, readonly, fluid, and unstyled state.

CANONICAL EXAMPLE
<neural-field controlId="biography" fluid>
  <label neuralFieldLabel>Biography</label>
  <textarea
    neuralTextarea
    autoResize
    [formField]="profileForm.biography"
  ></textarea>
  <small neuralFieldHint>Maximum 500 characters.</small>
</neural-field>
